brief:
Armed Israeli settlers tried to break into a Palestinian grandfather's home in Umm Safa village, according to Al Jazeera English. The attack is part of escalating pressure on the resident, who also faces a demolition order issued by Israeli forces against his property.

The incident occurred in Umm Safa, located in the central West Bank, where Palestinian families have confronted both settler violence and military-backed housing demolitions in recent months. Repeated clashes between residents and settlers have marked the village over that period.
dek: A Palestinian man is facing Israeli settler attacks and a demolition order from Israeli forces in Umm Safa village.
title: Israeli settlers attempt to storm Palestinian home in West Bank village
